paite: Huan David sih ni ding ahong naita a; atapa Solomon thu apia hi.
heading: David In Solomon Athuhilhna Nanung
english: Now the days of David came near that he should die; and he commanded Solomon his son, saying,

paite: "Leitung pumpi lampi ah ka pai sam dia; nang hattak leh pasalphatak in om in.
english: “I am going the way of all the earth. You be strong therefore, and show yourself a man;

paite: Na thilhih peuhmah leh na kiheina lam peuhmah a na lamzan theihna ding in Mosi Dan a gelh ahih bang in, TOUPA na Pathian in alampite zui ding leh adan thusehte, athupiakte, avaihawmte leh athu theihsakte pom dia thu apiakte zui in.
english: and keep the instruction of Yahweh your God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, his commandments, his ordinances, and his testimonies, according to that which is written in the law of Moses, that you may prosper in all that you do and wherever you turn yourself.

paite: TOUPA'N ka tungtang thu a, 'Na suante'n alungtang tengteng uleh alungsimtak ua ka mitmuh a thutak a-om ding a, a-omdan ua apilvan uleh Israelte laltutphah a tu ding mi na tatlak kei ding, chi a agen ahihkip ding hi.’ ”
english: Then Yahweh may establish his word which he spoke concerning me, saying, ‘If your children are careful of their way, to walk before me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul, there shall not fail you,’ he said, ‘a man on the throne of Israel.’

paite: "Zeruiah tapa Joab in ahon bawldan, Israelte sepaih heutu nih Ner tapa Abner leh Jether tapa Amasa abawldan na thei hi. Amaute athah a, kilep lai a kidou sisan suah a, atai a kawnggak leh akhedap but a kidouna sisan abansakdan.
english: “Moreover you know also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me, even what he did to the two captains of the armies of Israel, to Abner the son of Ner and to Amasa the son of Jether, whom he killed, and shed the blood of war in peace, and put the blood of war on his sash that was around his waist and in his sandals that were on his feet.

paite: Huchi in pha na sakdan bang in hih inla, alu a kelsam pou in han ah lungmuangtak in tumsak ke'n.
english: Do therefore according to your wisdom, and don’t let his gray head go down to Sheol in peace.

paite: Gilead mi Barzillai tapate tung ah hehpihna hihlang in. Na dohkan a an ummi ding in telsak in; na unau Absalom a pan ka taimang lai in ka kiang ah ahong ngal a.
english: But show kindness to the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be among those who eat at your table; for so they came to me when I fled from Absalom your brother.

paite: Ngai in Bahurim mi, Benjamin suan Gera tapa Shimei na kiang ah a-om hi. Ama'n Mahanaim a ka hoh lai in hamse hoihloupi ahon lohkhum hi. Himahleh Jordan ah hong dawn ding in ahong kuan hi. Huai ah, namsau in ka hon that kei ding, chi in TOUPA min lou in akiang ah ka na kichiamta hi.
english: “Behold, there is with you Shimei the son of Gera, the Benjamite of Bahurim, who cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim; but he came down to meet me at the Jordan, and I swore to him by Yahweh, saying, ‘I will not put you to death with the sword.’

paite: Huchi in moh lou in zaw koih ke'n; Mipil na hi ngal a. Atung ah bangchi in na hih dia chih ahihleh na thei mai ding. Alu a kelsam pou in sisan toh han ah na tumsak ding ahi," achi hi.
english: Now therefore don’t hold him guiltless, for you are a wise man; and you will know what you ought to do to him, and you shall bring his gray head down to Sheol with blood.”

paite: David bel apute kiang ah a-ihmu samta a, David khopi ah avui uhi.
heading: David Sihna
english: David slept with his fathers, and was buried in David’s city.

paite: Israelte tung a David lal sung kum sawmli ahi. Hebron ah kum sagih alal a, Jerusalem ah kum sawmthum-le-thum alal hi.
english: The days that David reigned over Israel were forty years; he reigned seven years in Hebron, and he reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem.

paite: Apa David laltutphah ah Solomon atu a; huchi in agam nakpitak a hihkip in ahong omta hi.
english: Solomon sat on David his father’s throne; and his kingdom was firmly established.

paite: Huan Solomon nu Bathsheba kiang ah Haggith tapa Adonijah ahoh a. Ama'n, "Hoih lam thu a hong na hi maw?" ana chi hi. Ama'n, "Hoih lam thu ah hi e,” achi hi.
heading: Adonijah Sihna
english: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith came to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon. She said, “Do you come peaceably?” He said, “Peaceably.

paite: "Na kiang ah banghiam gen ding ka nei hi," achi nawn a, ama'n, "Gen ve," achi hi.
english: He said moreover, I have something to tell you.” She said, “Say on.”

paite: Ama’n “Lalgam kei a ahita chih leh Israelte tengteng in leng kimpipa ding in kei ahon en gige uh chih na thei. Himahleh ka unaupa a ding in lalgam hei a om a, TOUPA sehdan in ka unaupa a ahong hita hi.
english: He said, “You know that the kingdom was mine, and that all Israel set their faces on me, that I should reign. However, the kingdom is turned around, and has become my brother’s; for it was his from Yahweh.

paite: Tu in thil khat nget ding ka hon nei a, hon nial ke’n,” ahi hi. Ama’n akiang ah, “Gen ve.” achi hi.
english: Now I ask one petition of you. Don’t deny me.” She said to him, “Say on.”

paite: Ama'n, "Hehpih in kumpipa Solomon hon houpihsak inla, na thu sel lou ding ahi ngal a, Shunam mi Abishag zi ding in hon neisak in," achi hi.
english: He said, “Please speak to Solomon the king (for he will not tell you ‘no’), that he give me Abishag the Shunammite as wife.”

paite: Bathsheba in, "Hileh ake, kumpipa ka hon na houpihsak ding," achi hi.
english: Bathsheba said, “All right. I will speak for you to the king.”

paite: Bathsheba in Adonijah a dia kumpipa Solomon houpih ding in akiang ah ahohta hi. Amah mu ding in kumpipa adingh a, ama ah akun a, alaltutphah ah atuta hi. Kumpipa nu a ding in laltutphah akoihsak a; ataklam ah atu hi.
english: Bathsheba therefore went to King Solomon, to speak to him for Adonijah. The king rose up to meet her and bowed himself to her, and sat down on his throne and caused a throne to be set for the king’s mother; and she sat on his right hand.

paite: "Thil neuchik khat ka hon ngen ut hi. Hon nial mahmah ke'n," achi hi. Kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Nu, hon ngen ve, ka hon phalsak lou kei ding," achi hi.
english: Then she said, “I ask one small petition of you; don’t deny me.” The king said to her, “Ask on, my mother, for I will not deny you.”

paite: Ama'n, "Shunam mi Abishag na unaupa Adonijah zi ding in neisak in," achi hi.
english: She said, “Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah your brother as wife.”

paite: Kumpipa Solomon in adawng a, anu kiang ah, "Bangchidan a Shunam mi Abishag, Adonijah a dia ngen na hia oi? Gam leng ngetsak vanglak tanla; amah ka u avo oi. Amah a ding leh siampu Abiathar leh Zeruiah tapa Joab a ding in leng ngen tanla," achi hi.
english: King Solomon answered his mother, “Why do you ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? Ask for him the kingdom also, for he is my elder brother; even for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah.”

paite: Kumpipa Solomon in TOUPA min lou in, "Adonijah thilnget in amah tung a sihna thu gen ahih kei himhimleh Pathian in alohloh in hon loh mai hen, huai sang a thupizaw in leng.
english: Then King Solomon swore by Yahweh, saying, “God do so to me, and more also, if Adonijah has not spoken this word against his own life.

paite: TOUPA, athuchiam bang a hon hihkip, ka pa David laltutphah a hon tusak, inkuan hon na phuhkhiaksakpa ahin bang in ka gen ahi. Adonijah tuni mahmah a asihsak ngeingei ding ahi," chi in akichiamta hi.
english: Now therefore as Yahweh lives, who has established me and set me on my father David’s throne, and who has made me a house as he promised, surely Adonijah shall be put to death today.”

paite: Huchi in kumpipa Solomon in Jehoiada tapa Benaiah asawl a, ama'n ava sual a, athatta hi.
english: King Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he fell on him, so that he died.

paite: Siampu Abiathar kiang ah kumpipa'n, "Anathoth a na inn-le-lou ah pai in, si tak lah na hi ngal a. Himahleh ka pa David ma a Toupa PATHIAN bawm na na zawn zel ziak in leh ka pa haksatna thuak tengteng na na thuak sam zel ziak in, tu in zaw ka hon that kei ding,” achi hi.
heading: Abiathar Hawlmangna Leh Joab Sihna
english: To Abiathar the priest the king said, “Go to Anathoth, to your own fields, for you are worthy of death. But I will not at this time put you to death, because you bore the Lord Yahweh’s ark before David my father, and because you were afflicted in all in which my father was afflicted.”

paite: Huchi in Solomon in Abiathar TOUPA siampu ahihna atawpsak hi. Hiai TOUPA'N Shiloh a Eli inkuante tungtang thu agen atangtun theihna ding ahi.
english: So Solomon thrust Abiathar out from being priest to Yahweh, that he might fulfill Yahweh’s word which he spoke concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh.

paite: Huai thu Joab kiang ahong tung a, Absalom lam ah Joab apang kei na a, Adonijah lam ah apang hi. Joab TOUPA puanin ah atai a, maitam kiite alen hi.
english: This news came to Joab; for Joab had followed Adonijah, although he didn’t follow Absalom. Joab fled to Yahweh’s Tent, and held onto the horns of the altar.

paite: "TOUPA puanin ah Joab atai a, ngai in, maitam bul ah a-om," chi in kumpipa Solomon ahilh uhi. Kumpipa Solomon in Jehoiada tapa Benaiah, va sual in, chi in asawl hi.
english: King Solomon was told, “Joab has fled to Yahweh’s Tent; and behold, he is by the altar.” Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, saying, “Go, fall on him.”

paite: Benaiah TOUPA puanin ah ahohtou a, akiang ah, "Kumpipa'n hong pawtkhia heh, achi,” achi hi. Ama'n, "Hilou e. Hiai ah ka si zaw ding,” achi hi. Benaiah in, “Joab in huchi in ahon na dawng hi,” chi in kumpipa kiang ah thu atun nawn hi.
english: Benaiah came to Yahweh’s Tent, and said to him, “The king says, ‘Come out!’” He said, “No; but I will die here.” Benaiah brought the king word again, saying, “This is what Joab said, and this is how he answered me.”

paite: Kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Achih bang in hih inla, va sual inla, vui in, aziak om het lou a Joab in sisan asuahna a pan kei leh ka pa inkote na hulsak theihna ding in," achi hi.
english: The king said to him, “Do as he has said, and fall on him, and bury him, that you may take away the blood, which Joab shed without cause, from me and from my father’s house.

paite: "Amah sang a kizenzaw leh hoihzaw mi nih, Ner tapa Abner, Israelte sepaih heutu leh Jether tapa Amasa, Judahte sepaih heutu ka pa David theih louh a sual a, namsau a athah ziak in TOUPA'N alutung ah asisan akiksak nawn ding hi.
english: Yahweh will return his blood on his own head, because he fell on two men more righteous and better than he, and killed them with the sword, and my father David didn’t know it: Abner the son of Ner, captain of the army of Israel, and Amasa the son of Jether, captain of the army of Judah.

paite: Huaiziak in asisan uh Joab lutung leh asuante lutung ah tangtawn in akik nawn dia; David leh asuante leh a-inkote leh alaltutphah tung ah TOUPA a pan lungmuanna tangtawn in a-om nilouh ding,” achi hi.
english: So their blood will return on the head of Joab and on the head of his offspring forever. But for David, for his offspring, for his house, and for his throne, there will be peace forever from Yahweh.”

paite: Huchi in Jehoiada tapa Benaiah va hohtou in ava sual a, athatta hi. Huchi in gamdai ah amah inn mah ah vui in a-om hi.
heading: Shimei Sihna
english: Then Benaiah the son of Jehoiada went up and fell on him, and killed him; and he was buried in his own house in the wilderness.

paite: Kumpipa'n sepaihte tung ah asik in Jehoiada tapa Benaiah apangsak hi. Kumpipa'n Abiathar sik in Siampu Zadok apangsak hi.
english: The king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his place over the army; and the king put Zadok the priest in the place of Abiathar.

paite: Kumpipa'n Shimei asamsak a, akiang ah, "Jerusalem ah inn kilam inla huai ah teng inla, huai a pan koi dang mah ah pawt ke'n.
english: The king sent and called for Shimei, and said to him, “Build yourself a house in Jerusalem, and live there, and don’t go anywhere else.

paite: Na pawt ni, Kidron lui na kan ni in na si ngeingei ding chỉh thei in. Na sisan nangmah lutung mah ah a-om ding," achi hi.
english: For on the day you go out and pass over the brook Kidron, know for certain that you will surely die. Your blood will be on your own head.”

paite: Shimei in kumpipa kiang ah, "Adik hi. TOUPA ka kumpipa'n agen bang in na sikha in ahih zel ding," achi hi. Huchi in Jerusalem ah Shimei sawtkuamtak ateng hi.
english: Shimei said to the king, “What you say is good. As my lord the king has said, so will your servant do.” Shimei lived in Jerusalem many days.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, kum thum nung in Shimei sikhate lak a nih, Gath kumpipa Maakah tapa Akish kiang ah ataimang uhi. "Ngai in, na sikhate Gath ah a-om uh," chi in Shimei ahilh uhi.
english: At the end of three years, two of Shimei’s slaves ran away to Achish, son of Maacah, king of Gath. They told Shimei, saying, “Behold, your slaves are in Gath.”

paite: Shimei athou a, asabiltung avan a, asikhate zong ding in Gath a Akish kiang ah ahohta hi. Shimei in Gath a pan asikhate ava pikik hi.
english: Shimei arose, saddled his donkey, and went to Gath to Achish to seek his slaves; and Shimei went and brought his slaves from Gath.

paite: Shimei Jerusalem a pan apawt a, Gath ah hoh in ahong kik nawn chi in Solomon ahilh uhi.
english: Solomon was told that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath, and had come again.

paite: Kumpipa'n Shimei asamsak a, akiang ah, "Na pawt ni, gamdang a na pawtkhiak ni in na si ngeingei ding, chi in TOUPA min lou a hon kichiamsak in, ka hon theisak ahi kei maw? Nangmah in leng ka kiang ah, na thugen ka zak ahoih hi, na chi hi.
english: The king sent and called for Shimei, and said to him, “Didn’t I adjure you by Yahweh and warn you, saying, ‘Know for certain that on the day you go out and walk anywhere else, you shall surely die’? You said to me, ‘The saying that I have heard is good.’

paite: Bangziak a TOUPA kichiamna leh ka hon thupiak zui lou na hia?" achi hi.
english: Why then have you not kept the oath of Yahweh and the commandment that I have instructed you with?”

paite: Kumpipa mah in Shimei kiang ah, "Na lungtang sunggil gitlouhdan, ka pa David tung a na gamtatdante na thei vek hi. Huchi in TOUPA'N na gitlouhna nangmah lutung ngei ah akiksak nawn ding.
english: The king said moreover to Shimei, “You know in your heart all the wickedness that you did to David my father. Therefore Yahweh will return your wickedness on your own head.

paite: Kumpipa Solomon vualzawl in a-om dia, David laltutphah TOUPA ma ah tangtawn in hihkip ahi ding,” achi hi.
english: But King Solomon will be blessed, and David’s throne will be established before Yahweh forever.”

paite: Huchi in kumpipa'n Jehoiada tapa Benaiah thu apia hi. Amah akuan a, ava sual a, athatta hi. Huchi in gam Solomon khut a hihkip in a-omta hi.
english: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he went out, and fell on him, so that he died. The kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon.
